name: @ladder/rung-7-shipped
description: Tutors ladder, rung 7 (Shipped): the rung 6 workspace as a versioned, gated, containerised release with checked claims, specified first in EARS and BDD

scripts.course: node apps/cli/src/main.ts --json-only ../fixtures/ladder-sample-course apps/reader/static/courses/ladder-sample-course && node apps/cli/src/main.ts --json-only tests/fixtures/hostile-course apps/reader/static/courses/hostile-course 2>/dev/null && node apps/cli/src/main.ts --json-only --private tests/fixtures/private-course apps/reader/static/courses/private-course
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/model && tsc -p packages/identity && tsc -p packages/rbac && tsc -p packages/gen && tsc -p packages/lite && tsc -p apps/cli && tsc -p . && pnpm --filter @ladder/reader check
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && vitest run && pnpm build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts tests/e2e
